import os,json,tempfile,stat
from pathlib import Path
p=Path("/home/appontrack/.ontrack-mobile/settings.json")
if not p.is_file() or p.is_symlink(): raise ValueError("Settings unavailable or symlink")
if os.getuid()!=2379: raise ValueError("Wrong account")
settings=json.loads(p.read_text())
before=settings.get("input_channel","right")
if before not in ("left","right","mix"): raise ValueError("Unknown channel; preserve")
revision=int(settings.get("revision",1))
if before!="mix":
 settings["input_channel"]="mix"
 settings["revision"]=revision+1
 fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".settings-",dir=str(p.parent))
 try:
  with os.fdopen(fd,"w") as f:
   json.dump(settings,f,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(",",":"))
   f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
  os.chmod(tmp,0o600);os.replace(tmp,p)
 finally:
  if os.path.exists(tmp):os.unlink(tmp)
print(json.dumps({"action":"audio_input_channel_test","previous_channel":before,"new_channel":settings.get("input_channel"),"previous_revision":revision,"new_revision":settings.get("revision"),"other_settings_preserved":True}))
